title: This is the future of the internet #shorts
description:
This is a peek into how the internet is gonna work in the future.

What you’re seeing is not a website…

It looks like it…but it’s actually a series of AI images being generated in real time.

Because it’s AI, every single thing on these pages is fully interactive.

Which makes it way more dynamic than a regular website.

For example…

I built a page to show how the underground tunnel system beneath Disney World actually works.

In 10 seconds it created this visual

But now I can literally click anywhere on this image to zoom in and learn more.

And I can do that endlessly.

So it’s like one of those never ending, infinite iPad zoom sketches, but for any topic you can imagine, generated instantly.

Now here’s why this symbolizes the future of the internet.

Today, all our websites are limited by buttons and boxes.

We can only see what the developer wrote and click on what they enabled to be clicked.

But now that AI image models can think and render perfect text in any style…it’s not crazy to assume that all webpages could be “generated live” on the spot like this.

And that would mean personalized websites for every user…

You and I go on the same brand site, but we’d have completely different experiences because the sites are generated live in real-time.

Now right now, this is just an experiment, but playing with it will really start to make you rethink how the internet’s gonna work.

If you want to try this out yourself, you can go to flipbook.page or comment “AI” and I’ll send you the link.
